notes.title: 🍌 Hidden Bananas is part of Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
🎮 Play the free Next Fest demo and share your feedback!🍌

 Hidden Bananas is joining Steam Next Fest from June 9 to 16!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694240"][/dynamiclink]
🔍 In this charming hidden object game, your mission is simple: find all the hidden bananas scattered across colorful and creative environments. Each level offers a new challenge full of surprises.

✨ Why wishlist Hidden Bananas?✅ Be the first to know when the game launches ✅ Help us grow and reach more players 

📅 Steam Next Fest runs from June 9 to 16💛 Thanks for your support — and happy banana hunting!
— the Hidden Bananas Team

notes.title: 🎉 Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy - Demo Now Available! 🍅🚜
notes.content:
🍅Get ready for a new hidden object challenge! The demo for Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy is now available on Steam. Explore a lively farm environment, test your observation skills, and find as many hidden tomatoes as you can!

🔍 What’s in the demo?

✅ A sneak peek at the farm-themed hidden object gameplay
✅ Beautiful rural scenery filled with well-hidden tomatoes
✅ A relaxing yet engaging experience for hidden object fans

🍅Try the demo now and get a taste of the full game🍅

notes.title: 🍅 100 Hidden Tomatoes Await You on the Farm! 🌾
notes.content:
📢 Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy is OUT NOW! 🚜🍅

It’s time to put your keen eyes to the test! Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy is now available! This time, you’ll explore a lively farm environment, searching for 100 hidden tomatoes. Can you find them all?

🔎 Game Features:
✅ A beautifully detailed farm to explore
✅ 100 hidden tomatoes in every stage
✅ Colorful and charming graphics
✅ A fun challenge for hidden object game fans

🔥 Get the game now and start your farm adventure!
